title: Crumbs: a directory that explains itself
summary: Drake's agents coordinate through the repository, not a chat log. Each directory carries a committed .crumb JSON: schema_version, name and purpose are required, layer, above, below, invariants, exports and extensions optional, and extensions.generated is written only by crumb compile. Locks (crumb claim) and whispers live in a shared store, not in the file. I can read real crumbs with you; an Omega checker lists their keys and flags legacy and invalid shapes.
goal: Read a real .crumb, know what each field is for and who writes it, and see why agents coordinate through the repository.
key_steps: Read the nearest crumb's purpose and invariants before touching a directory
Claim a path with crumb claim before a multi-step change; exit 2 means someone holds it
Leave findings with crumb whisper, never secrets
Never hand-edit extensions.generated; run crumb compile
Run crumb verify before committing, and commit crumbs with the work

example.code:
note crumbchk: read a .crumb (JSON) on stdin, list its top-level keys and judge its shape
note RFC-0001 requires schema_version, name, purpose and allows layer above below invariants exports extensions;
note anything else at the top level is invalid (additionalProperties false). The older Rust writer used
note version dir_path history whispers description dir_name: that is the legacy shape.
note exit 0 RFC-0001 shape, 3 LEGACY, 4 INVALID missing required key, 5 INVALID unknown key, 6 not JSON-shaped
text keys "schema_version name purpose layer above below invariants exports extensions version dir_path history whispers description dir_name generated "
text tkey "key "
text treq " (required)\n"
text topt " (optional)\n"
text tleg " (legacy)\n"
text tunk " (UNKNOWN)\n"
text tgen "extensions.generated present: written by crumb compile, never by hand\n"
text vok "verdict RFC-0001 shape: required keys present, no unknown keys\n"
text vleg "verdict LEGACY shape: left as it is; a new crumb never copies it\n"
text vmiss "verdict INVALID: a required key is missing\n"
text vunk "verdict INVALID: unknown top-level key\n"
text vbad "verdict NOT_JSON_SHAPED\n"
note js: 0 depth, 1 in string, 2 escape, 3 last string start, 4 last string end, 5 required bits, 6 legacy, 7 unknown
global js ulong 9
fn onkey to void
note a ":" was read: the last string is a key at the current depth
a = get js 3
b = get js 4
k = lookup keys a b
d = get js 0
if eq d 2
if eq k 15
put js 8 1
end
end
if eq d 1
ot tkey
oi a b
if lt k 0
put js 7 add get js 7 1
ot tunk
else
if lt k 3
put js 5 or get js 5 shl ulong 1 ulong k
ot treq
else
if lt k 9
ot topt
else
if lt k 15
put js 6 add get js 6 1
ot tleg
else
put js 7 add get js 7 1
ot tunk
end
end
end
end
end
end
fn instr c uchar i ulong to void
if eq get js 2 1
put js 2 0
else
if eq c 92
put js 2 1
end
if eq c 34
put js 1 0
put js 4 i
end
end
end
fn outstr c uchar i ulong to bool
note false when a closing bracket has no opener
if eq c 34
put js 1 1
put js 3 add i 1
end
if or eq c 123 eq c 91
put js 0 add get js 0 1
end
if or eq c 125 eq c 93
if eq get js 0 0
ret false
end
put js 0 sub get js 0 1
end
if eq c 58
onkey
end
ret true
end
fn verdict to int
if ne add get js 0 get js 1 0
ot vbad
ret 6
end
if gt get js 7 0
ot vunk
ret 5
end
if gt get js 6 0
ot vleg
ret 3
end
if ne get js 5 7
ot vmiss
ret 4
end
ot vok
ret 0
end
fn main to int
r = rdall
if lt r 0
ret 6
end
if eq get st 2 1
ret 6
end
ok = true
for i ulong ulong r
c = get inb i
if eq get js 1 1
instr c i
else
if not outstr c i
ok = false
break
end
end
end
if eq get js 8 1
ot tgen
end
v = int 6
if ok
v = verdict
else
ot vbad
end
f = flush
ret v
end

common_mistake: Adding a directory without a crumb: verify stays green and the directory is invisible to agents. Run crumb seed and write a real purpose. Hand-editing extensions.generated passes locally and fails in CI.
